candidateAssessments.name: Public Domain Lyrics Database (PubDomainOnly)
candidateAssessments.coverageClaim: 1,334 public-domain songs limited to US publication cutoff 1928 or earlier; 3,653 CC0 original songs; categories include hymns, folk songs, spirituals and ballads; maintainer says 87% of PD entries have source URLs.
reasonsToDefer: US-only public-domain claim does not establish rights in other jurisdictions
part of CC0 collection is automatically generated and requires quality/provenance assessment
no stable item ID in documented field shape
Wikisource and Open Hymnal overlap unmeasured
candidateAssessments.licenseTerms: LICENSE.md differentiates source-code MIT from CC0 lyrics (contributors waive rights to the extent possible) and a separate collection of works believed to be US public domain; country status may vary and entries need verification.

candidateAssessments.name: Pesna.org / Macedonian Folk Songs
candidateAssessments.decision: defer at discovery stage; no registry entry
candidateAssessments.evidence: Publisher search page documents Macedonian folk-song search, Cyrillic/Latin transliteration and translations including English, French, Greek, Polish, Russian and Turkish. It claims website materials are CC BY, folk-song lyrics are public domain, and requests a backlink; audio is separately rights-limited. No public API or machine-readable extraction contract was found in the reviewed publisher page.
candidateAssessments.reason: Potentially useful regional coverage, but website reachability/search UI is not an API or proof of compatible identity/extraction; attribution and per-item provenance need review.

candidateAssessments.name: Serdica Digital Platform Bulgarian Folk Songs item
candidateAssessments.decision: reject this item as a lyrics source; retain no registry candidate
candidateAssessments.evidence: Library record describes a 1961, 694-page fourth edition and scanned PDF. It offers Atom, Dublin Core XML, JSON and Omeka XML exports for the item record, not structured song lyrics.
candidateAssessments.reason: Bibliographic metadata export and digitized book are not a lyric extraction API; edition rights and per-work rights were not established.

candidateAssessments.name: Bulgarian National Corpus
candidateAssessments.evidence: Publisher terms restrict access to noncommercial scientific research, education or private study; the corpus includes copyrighted texts and is not downloadable in full.
candidateAssessments.reason: Not a suitable open song catalog/API for an app library.

candidateAssessments.name: Choral Public Domain Library (CPDL/ChoralWiki)
candidateAssessments.decision: reject for this discovery pass; no registry entry
candidateAssessments.evidence: Publisher forum describes a MediaWiki API and category member queries for scores; catalog is primarily choral score discovery, with text/score availability and rights varying by item.
candidateAssessments.reason: A score/category API does not establish lyric extraction or per-work rights; overlaps existing hymn/choral candidates and offers no clear new compatible source in this bounded check.
